entities.summary: Sarah Bush Lincoln was the second wife of Thomas Lincoln and stepmother of Abraham Lincoln. She was born in Kentucky to Christopher and Hannah Bush. Lincoln married her first husband, Daniel Johnston, in 1806, and they had three children. Daniel died in 1816, and she married widower Thomas Lincoln three years later, joining his family with her three children.
